jei.wariumce.setup.assembly: Place an assembly машина above the depot, a production input behind it and a production output in front. Install the indicated mechanical tool in the assembly машина. Base crafting time is calculated from the processing ticks at standard машина speed; faster машины finish sooner. Tools wear while crafting.
jei.wariumce.setup.assembly_centrifuge: Use a centrifuge middle between a centrifuge bottom and top, with a giant coil below the bottom. Put production input behind and output in front of the middle. Crafting time is calculated from processing ticks. Enrichment uses the world setting in singleplayer and shows the default on multiplayer servers, where the setting may differ. Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.assembly_circuit_fabr: Place a production input behind the fabricator and a production output in front. Unfabricated tech components become tech components after 600 processing updates plus the output update: 3,005 ticks (150.25 seconds). Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.assembly_crusher: Place a production input behind and a production output in front. Install an железный шестерня or стальной crushing wheel. Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.assembly_furnace: Place a production input behind and a production output in front of the heated assembly furnace. Requires at least 200 тепло and uses smelting recipes. Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.assembly_mechanical_f: Place a production input behind the fabricator and a production output in front. алюминиевый блоки become precision components; продвинутый alloy ingots become продвинутый alloy components. Each recipe takes 600 processing updates plus the output update: 3,005 ticks (150.25 seconds). Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.blast_furnace: Place three blast funnels above the furnace and тепло it to at least 200 using a firebox. Put one ingredient in each input slot. Ingredients may be swapped.
jei.wariumce.setup.breeder_reactor: Use a breeder реактор interface above a core and port, with two levels of four ready reaction chambers around the core/interface. Feed enriched урановый пыль or enriched литиевый ingots into the interface and extract the product from the port. Duration is twice the enrichment-time game rule.
jei.wariumce.setup.chemical_digester: Place a production input behind the digester and a production output in front. Put nitrate in the digester slot. Each batch takes 10 ticks (0.5 seconds), with an 80% chance of the основное product and separate 5% chances for each byproduct. Each batch has a 6.25% chance to consume one nitrate. Unsupported inputs pass through unchanged.
jei.wariumce.setup.foundry: тепло the foundry to at least 200 using a firebox. Insert the indicated материалы and casting template. Templates are reusable.
jei.wariumce.setup.mineral_grinder: Put the input in slot 0 and an железный шестерня or стальной crushing wheel in the tool slot, then use the grinding button. The tool wears with use. The second output has a 25% chance.
jei.wariumce.setup.refinery: Stack four refinery towers above the refinery and тепло the base to at least 200. Each shale oil produces 250 mB in each tower: oil, diesel, kerosene, then petroleum from bottom to top. All four towers need room for a full batch.
jei.wariumce.setup.thermal_furnace: Place three blast funnels above the furnace and supply at least 200 тепло from a firebox. Uses smelting recipes; no furnace топливо предмет is required in the furnace itself.
